warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Steel, a shield and the forge. Stands in the middle of the fight and stays there.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Bow, wild and long roads. Sees it first, hits it from far away.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Quiet feet, quick hands, a quick tongue for when both fail.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: The College's road: Ruin, Shaping, Mending, runes and the alchemist's bench.

spellsword.name: Spellsword
spellsword.description: A blade in one hand and a spell in the other, and the knack of putting one into the other.

nightblade.name: Nightblade
nightblade.description: Shadows, glamours and the old hunger. Strikes from nowhere and takes something back.

tide_warden.name: Tide-Warden
tide_warden.description: Keeps the old watch on the moons. Heavy steel, a heavy blade and the tide behind them.

battlemage.name: Battlemage
battlemage.description: Fights in the thick of it with Ruin on their hands and bound things at their back.

binder.name: Binder
binder.description: Calls things, binds things, commands them. Rarely fights alone.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.description: Bare hands, long legs and a healer's knack. Goes anywhere, carries little.

herald.name: Herald
herald.description: A voice people follow: speaks first, shoots second, and brings friends.

hedge_witch.name: Hedge Witch
hedge_witch.description: The old ways: drawing, brewing, binding and bargains best not looked at closely.
